name: Weekend plan
description: NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory in three sizes: Ultra plans the weekend (thinking first), Lightning checks it against the budget, and Super writes the message to your partner once you approve. With TAVILY_API_KEY set, the plan's facts (train times, prices, opening hours) are checked on the web before you're asked. Needs NEBIUS_API_KEY.
example: A weekend in Mysuru for two from Bengaluru, by train, under ₹8,000. We're vegetarian and don't drink.

assistants.name: Planner (Nemotron Ultra)
assistants.description: Plans with several steps or trade-offs: trips, budgets, schedules, decisions.

assistants.name: Budget check (Nemotron Lightning)
assistants.description: Quick checks, sums and yes-or-no answers.

assistants.name: Writer (Nemotron Super)
assistants.description: Writes emails, messages and posts in the person's voice.

steps.ask:
Plan this weekend for me: {{input}}

Day by day, with times and costs in rupees. Then a last line of JSON: {"summary": "<the plan in one line>", "total": <the total cost in rupees, a number>}

steps.message:
This plan may be over budget ({{check.data.why}}). Send it to your partner anyway?

{{plan.text}}

Send this plan to your partner?

{{plan.text}}

steps.ask:
Write a short, warm message to my partner about this weekend plan, ready to send:

{{plan.text}}
